description: This file is a header file (`channelManager.h`) that declares functions, macros, and data structures for managing communication channels within a software system. It defines an interface for initializing, shutting down, querying, and controlling various communication channels (e.g., TCP, UDP, HTTPS, MQTT) used for server communication, including status reporting, event broadcasting, and connection testing.

methods.name: initChannelManager
methods.description: Initializes the channel manager subsystem during startup.

methods.name: shutdownChannelManager
methods.description: Shuts down the channel manager subsystem during shutdown.

methods.name: inChannelStartupWindow
methods.description: Returns whether the system is within the startup window for channel initialization.

methods.name: getChannelById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific communication channel by its unique identifier.

methods.name: channelIsAnythingOnline
methods.description: Checks if any communication channel is currently online.

methods.name: channelGetOnlineDetailedStatus
methods.description: Populates detailed online status information for all channels.

methods.name: channelSendCommOnlineChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends an event notification when the online status of channels changes.

methods.name: getChannelRuntimeStatusIPC
methods.description: Provides the current runtime status information of channels for external IPC.

methods.name: collectChannelMessageStatisticsIPC
methods.description: Collects and provides message transmission statistics for channels.

methods.name: channelConfigurationRestoredIPC
methods.description: Notifies channels of restored configuration and returns success status.

methods.name: channelConfigurationResetToDefaultsIPC
methods.description: Instructs channels to reset to default configuration.

methods.name: channelSendMessageToSubscriberIPC
methods.description: Sends a message to a subscriber via channels.

methods.name: channelGetCloudAssociationStateIPC
methods.description: Retrieves cloud association state information from channels.

methods.name: channelStartManualCloudAssociationIPC
methods.description: Initiates manual cloud association process via channels.

methods.name: channelGetHostnameConfigurationListIPC
methods.description: Retrieves hostname configuration list from channels.

methods.name: channelSetHostnameConfigurationListIPC
methods.description: Sets hostname configuration list on channels.

methods.name: destroyChannelTestResult
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a channel test result.

methods.name: channelPerformConnectionTests
methods.description: Performs connection tests on channels, returning results.
